title: Code and data for 'Attributing and Budgeting the Cost of Agentic AI Under Stated Uncertainty'
description: Scripts, per-task cost tables and result files that reproduce the budget-coverage pilot (E1, E1c) and the illustrative case study in the accompanying paper. Per-task costs are recomputed at dated list prices from public Holistic Agent Leaderboard traces; see data/PROVENANCE.md.
